top_signals.title: Ex-French Fighter Pilot Charged in Foreign Spying Case
top_signals.summary: A former French fighter pilot was charged over suspicions he collected and provided classified information to a foreign power, according to Paris prosecutors.

top_signals.summary: South Korea’s stock market is displaying what would appear to be clear dip‑buying signs: July’s record 34% plunge that has left the benchmark Kospi at its cheapest valuation ever.
